info.name: Exactly Protocol Auditor ERC-4626 Liquidations API
Calculate assets to seize during liquidation

items.docs: Calculates the amount of collateral to seize from a borrower during liquidation, accounting for the liquidation incentive and lender fees.

info.name: Check liquidation eligibility and maximum repay

items.docs: Verifies that a liquidation is valid and computes the maximum assets the liquidator is allowed to repay given the dynamic close factor.
Liquidates a borrower's variable rate debt when their health factor falls below the threshold. The liquidator repays up to maxAssets of debt and receives collateral from the seizeMarket.

info.name: Clear bad debt for a borrower

items.docs: Clears bad debt from a borrower's account by using the earnings accumulator. Only callable when the borrower's collateral has been fully seized.
